lines.text: The heavens declare the glory of God day after day and night after night, without any sound.
Like a shepherd emerging from his chamber, the sun runs its circuit from one end of the heavens.
The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul, and the fear of the LORD endures forever.
The LORD's commands are more precious than silver and sweeter than honey, and keeping them brings great reward.
David asks God to cleanse his hidden faults, keep him from willful sins, and find his words pleasing.
